original_description: Connect your VIXNODE account to plan, design, create and manage websites in ChatGPT. Work with projects, pages, drafts, previews, domains, SEO, media and publication. Use reusable industry, style, color and multilingual typography guidance with immersive spatial design resources. Test and manage project API data sources, review actual data and field Display Names before saving, and generate task-specific webpage bindings or form calls.
